source.title: Breaking News Sends Stock from $3.00 to $12.45 in 2hrs!

symbol_correction.reason: The transcript-derived ONCS symbol is inconsistent with historical market data. On the video's March 27, 2026 date, independent same-day reporting identifies Artelo Biosciences (ARTL) as a leading momentum stock, with a prior close of $3.19 and an intraday high reported at exactly $12.45, matching the unusually specific price path in the video title.

public_research.observation: Indexes Ross Cameron's video with the exact title and March 27, 2026 publication date.
March 27 report says ARTL had closed at $3.19 and reached exactly $12.45 intraday while up more than 200%.
Confirms ARTL's March 26 close near $3.19 and extraordinary March 27 momentum/volume.
Confirms material March 27 news/filing activity in ARTL during the same session.

research_notes: This is a deliberately included negative outcome: a micro entry was taken, initially moved slightly higher, then rejected and stopped out.
The original transcript-derived ticker ONCS was corrected to ARTL only after independent public market-data verification; the behavioral labels were not changed to fit the runtime strategy.
Primary scoring should test whether Micro v0.1 causally produces a comparable setup/entry and whether the later campaign engine exits on failure; profit magnitude is not a calibration target.
This retrospective label must never be supplied to a policy replaying March 27, 2026.
